sources.snippet: Gemma 4 - 31B x Claude Opus 4.6 is a highly capable model fine-tuned on top of the powerful unsloth/gemma-4-31B-it architecture. The model's core directive is to absorb state-of-the-art reasoning distillation, primarily sourced from Claude-4.6 Opus interactions.
